patternRecipes.name: Create Resource pattern
patternRecipes.purpose: Derived creation flow pattern for Azure resources when the direct Create Resource Figma node is notice-only.
patternRecipes.provenance: derived-from-related-patterns; direct Create Resource node exposes only Design System Update Notice.
layoutAnatomy: fixed FormFooter with primary Create and secondary/back/cancel actions
accessibilityAndInteraction: step buttons expose current selection by primary appearance and remain keyboard buttons
validation summary appears before form content
footer actions are standard Fluent buttons
consumer owns focus management after validation errors
doUseFor: Create flows where related Forms and Step Wizard patterns apply
doNotUseFor: Direct Figma parity claims for node 6672:54683
patternRecipes.implementationSkeleton: <CreateResourcePattern title="Create resource" steps={steps} currentStepId={stepId} onStepSelect={setStepId} validationSummary={errors} primaryAction={{id:"create",label:"Create",onClick:create}} secondaryAction={{id:"previous",label:"Previous",onClick:previous}} />

props: steps: Array<{ id; label; content; disabled? }>

slots: step.content
reviewContent
feedback
title/subtitle/actions via BladeHeader/FormFooter
patternRecipes.stateModel: Controlled currentStepId; caller owns form values, validation state, submission/loading, and success navigation.
patternRecipes.accessibility: Use semantic h1, real buttons for steps/actions, MessageBar for validation summary, labeled fields inside step content, and focus management by caller on validation errors.
patternRecipes.exampleUsage: <CreateResourcePattern title="Create storage account" currentStepId={step} steps={steps} validationSummary={summary} primaryAction={{id:"create", label:"Create", loading: saving, onClick: submit}} />
patternRecipes.confidence: medium-high for derived composition; low for direct Figma parity
remainingUnknowns: Direct Create Resource anatomy is not published in Figma; revisit when node 6672:54683 exposes usable frames.
